(* Heavier GC stress: large live heap + lots of garbage + integrity check *)
let () =
  let n = 200_000 in
  let live = Array.init n (fun i -> i * 7) in
  for round = 0 to 30 do
    let _garbage = List.init 5000 (fun i -> String.make 100 (Char.chr (i mod 94 + 33))) in
    Gc.full_major ()
  done;
  (* verify integrity after all GCs *)
  let bad = ref 0 in
  for i = 0 to n - 1 do if live.[i] <> i * 7 then bad := !bad + 1 done;
  if !bad = 0 then print_endline "INTEGRITY OK"
  else (Printf.eprintf "CORRUPTION: %d bad cells\n" !bad; exit 1)
EOF
